properties.notes: Former school that is now surplus to requirements following closure in 2014. Now available, with the redundant school buildings requiring clearance prior to redevelopment. A suitable scheme would be for the brownfield land and would not include the associated playing fields. Planning permission has been granted for demolition of the vacant school buildings and redevelopment of the land for 14 units (17/01123/FUL). The proposal is for a mix of townhouses and bungalows. Development is limited to the footprint of the former buildings and hardstanding not the adjacent playing fields. Site under-construction and forecast for completion within the next 5 years.
properties.site-address: St Cuthberts RC First School, Links Road, Amble
